tokens.v: Disregard the hoodie and its printed wordmark — the subject is the eyewear. Blow it to poster scale: crop to the double bridge and near lens until each halftone dot stands a centimetre across, the temple arm running out through the right edge, the gradient lens dissolving into dot-field below. Safety-orange sits a dot off register along the lens rim, ink proud on the paper tooth, fibre nap lifting through it. SOLSTICE reverses out of the black at the lens corner, letters standing large and clean at this poster magnification, same slip. 50mm at f/8 square to the sheet; a lifted paper corner curls soft through the bottom-right, cut by it.
